articles.title: The protests spread to other cities in Italy
articles.description: Protests have spread this Saturday to the main cities of Italy, after a protest last weekend against the rising cost of living and the deterioration of purchasing power degenerated into serious riots and looting in Milan, in the north of the country, and ended with 200 people arrested. On this occasion, there has been a new demonstration in Milan, but also in Rome, Turin, Florence, Naples, and Bologna. All have taken place without serious incidents, but there have been moments of tension. The police have arrested a total of nine people across the country, identified 4,292, and taken 371 to the police station, 110 of whom are minors.
